start.card:
Two hospitals. The small one has 15 babies born every day. The big one has 45.
Every baby has the same 50/50 chance of being a boy or a girl. But some days, more than 60% of the babies are boys (that means more than 6 out of every 10).
Over one year, which hospital has more of those days? Make your guess below.
start.title: Small hospital, big hospital

afterGuess.card:
You guessed: the small hospital. Now let's live through a year.
Press Next day to see one day of births in both hospitals: blue is a boy, pink is a girl.
afterGuess.title: Small hospital, big hospital
visibleButtons: Run the rest of the year

after.card:
Year done. 15 babies a day: 47 days over 60% boys. 45 babies a day: 27 days.
Takeaway: the fewer babies a day, the further a day can swing from half boys. So a small hospital has more lopsided days, even though every baby is still 50/50.
after.title: Small hospital, big hospital
